name: 11 Qualification and proving
intro: What must pass before v1 launches: development tests, the qualification harness and its separate OS user, fault injection and replay, the fixture repository, the 47 cases, the qualification record and doctor's self-check, and the nine proving scenarios with their checklists, verdicts and record. One question comes from a silence in the sources; everything else is stated as already decided. When you accept it I commit it and start the milestone documents with M0 Groundwork.
notes: The case table (rule 24) gives each case's wording from AssemblyAI#12 with the document and milestone from 00's traceability table, so the two must stay in step; 00 keeps the short form.
Rule 28 and rule 38 carry AssemblyAI#27's proving-and-launch row, which has no milestone document of its own.
Rules 25 and 36 read "AssemblyAI" in AssemblyAI#12 as talvor/asmai, as AssemblyAI#27's comment on that ticket says.
Rule 12 does not list which cases depend on the provider; that split is part of the harness's design.
